scenario:
A national powerlifting federation is developing an enterprise-level system to manage and analyze data from powerlifting competitions across various divisions and weight classes. The system needs to handle detailed records of each event, including participant information, team affiliations, and their performance metrics such as squat, bench press, and deadlift results.

The federation's platform should allow for the categorization of competitions by division, weight class, and equipment type. It should also provide analytics to assess participant performance trends over time, compare results across different events, and manage the registration and eligibility of athletes based on their age and sex.

Additionally, the system should support detailed reporting on team standings, individual rankings, and historical performance data. This will help in organizing future events, enhancing athlete training programs, and increasing the visibility of powerlifting as a sport. The platform must also include robust user management to control access levels for competition organizers, coaches, athletes, and fans.
